title: Legal Administrative Assistant/Secretary
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Legal Administrative Assistant/Secretary em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

This is the role where attorneys stop worrying about whether anything is going to slip through the cracks. Calendars they trust. Dockets that don't drift. Court, BIA, and tribal-court filings that always go through. Billing that closes on schedule. Confidential records handled with the discretion the work requires. Our client is a leading Arizona litigation firm headquartered in Phoenix, with active practices in commercial litigation, civil rights, employment law, and Federal Indian Law — including matters before the Bureau of Indian Affairs and tribal courts. The firm represents businesses, individuals, families, and tribal nation interests, and offers the expertise of large national firms with a smaller, more personal approach. The firm runs on Clio for case management, calendaring, and billing. You will support attorneys and the onshore team directly — owning the operational discipline that determines whether the lawyers can focus on the law or get pulled into the operational background. This is a substantive operational ownership role, not a queue-clearing admin seat. Success at 90 days: zero missed deadlines, calendars attorneys rely on without checking twice, clean billing close, organized matter files. Success at one year: you know BIA procedures and tribal court rules well enough that attorneys default to you for procedural questions, not the other way around. Key Responsibilities  Docketing & Calendar Management  Docket hearings, court dates, filing deadlines, BIA deadlines, tribal court deadlines, and critical case milestones in Clio. Set structured multi-tier reminder cascades for every deadline (30-day, 14-day, 7-day, 2-day, day-of) — never a single calendar entry. Manage attorney calendars including appointments, court dates, depositions, agency hearings, internal deadlines, and travel windows. Surface upcoming deadlines and scheduling conflicts to attorneys with sufficient lead time — proactively, not reactively.  Meeting, Deposition & Travel Coordination  Coordinate scheduling for client meetings, depositions, hearings, agency appearances, and internal team meetings. Arrange travel logistics for attorneys (flights, accommodations, transportation, itineraries) for hearings and client visits. Prepare deposition logistics including notices, court reporter coordination, and witness confirmation. Confirm all logistics in advance and communicate relevant details to all parties.  Legal Document Preparation  Prepare, edit, proofread, and format pleadings, motions, briefs, correspondence, and other legal materials to filing-ready quality. Ensure all documents meet applicable court, agency, and firm formatting standards before filing or distribution. Maintain version control and organized document files across all active matters inside Clio. Assist attorneys with drafting standard correspondence and follow-up communications as directed.  Court & Agency Filing  E-file with federal district courts (CM-ECF/PACER), Arizona state courts, BIA, and tribal courts as applicable. Confirm acceptance of every filing via NEF or equivalent — submission is not the same as acceptance. Maintain organized records of all submissions, confirmations, and proofs of service. Stay current on e-filing requirements for the courts and agencies the firm uses.  Case & File Management (Clio)  Maintain matter records inside Clio with consistent naming conventions and complete metadata. Track case activity and organize supporting documentation. Maintain and organize physical and digital client files. Handle confidential client records and case information with the highest level of discretion and in compliance with applicable professional responsibility rules. Support case intake — opening new matters in Clio, gathering client information, preparing conflict checks.  Billing, Invoicing & Expense Tracking  Track attorney time entries, billing activity, and client invoices inside Clio. Assist with preparation and distribution of client billing statements. Process and track expense reports and reimbursements. Flag missing time entries, overdue invoices, or discrepancies to the appropriate team member before billing close.  Compliance & Procedure  Maintain awareness of procedural rules relevant to the firm's Indian law practice — federal administrative procedures, tribal court rules, federal court local rules, BIA processes. Support the firm's compliance with document retention, confidentiality, and professional responsibility obligations. Ensure all administrative procedures comply with applicable legal, court, and agency requirements.  Required Qualifications  2+ years in a legal admin, legal secretary, or paralegal role supporting a US litigation practice (or strongly comparable international firm). Hands-on US court e-filing experience (CM-ECF, PACER, AZTurboCourt, or similar) — direct workflow experience, not familiarity. Direct experience managing multiple attorney calendars with structured, multi-tier deadline cascades. Excellent written English — documents you prepare or proofread require minimal attorney correction. Meticulous attention to detail. Accuracy in legal documents and deadlines is non-negotiable. High discretion in handling confidential client and case information. Self-directed and reliable in a remote work environment. Stable home office: high-speed internet, backup power or backup internet, quiet workspace, modern computer with webcam.  Strong Plus, Not Required  Direct paid Clio experience — matter setup, calendar integration, document management, and billing. Equivalent experience with Filevine, MyCase, ProLaw, Smokeball, or comparable case management systems. Familiarity with Bureau of Indian Affairs procedures, tribal court rules, or federal administrative practice. Experience with LEDES invoicing or other legal billing standards. 12+ months of sustained US-firm remote experience.  How We Work  100% remote. full-time contractor. Compensation: up to $6/hr USD.  Application  Complete the required Aptive Index assessment here and provide a comprehensive resume. Link:  By applying, you consent to being contacted via the contact information provided in your application for recruitment purposes only. Scheduling: initial calls run in US Mountain Standard Time, within a 3:00 AM – 1:00 PM MST window — which translates locally to 6:00 PM – 4:00 AM in the Philippines, 12:00 PM – 10:00 PM in South Africa, 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM in Brazil, and 4:00 AM – 2:00 PM in Guatemala.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (German)
description:

About Turing:   Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L. Role Overview:  As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Key Qualifications:  German Proficiency: Ability to read and write in German with a high degree of comp, as German is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.  Description:  In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied. Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.  Education & Experience:  BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.  Offer Details:  Commitments Required:  at least 4 hours per day and upto 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type:  Contractor Engagement Length:  3 months Our offered rate for this project is $15 per hour.   Evaluation Process:  Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form . After the profile review, an assessment  will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .  After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. A solução antecipa gargalos, melhora a previsibilidade da circulação dos trens e apoia decisões estratégicas para otimização da capacidade e desempenho da malha. Implementar testes automáticos. Criar SLAs de dados. Monitorar e alertar falhas. Atuar junto aos domínios na correção de problemas.  Experiência  Sólida experiência com AWS (EC2, ECS, EKS, S3, RDS, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch). Experiência em mensurar métricas de qualidade. Experiência com testes de qualidade de dados. Conhecimentos técnicos:  AWS (EC2, ECS, EKS, S3, RDS, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch). Governança de dados. Catálogo e metadados. Compliance e LGPD.  Informações adicionais  Modelo de Trabalho  Regime de trabalho: Híbrido (3x2) Modelo de contratação: CLT Local de trabalho: Indaiatuba Horário de trabalho: Comercial Exigências de viagem: Eventual  Pacote de Benefícios  Vale Alimentação Vale Refeição Vale Transporte Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR) Bônus de Segurança Ferroviária Previdência Privada Cooperativa de Crédito Empréstimo Consignado Wellhub Plano de Saúde Plano Odontológica Instrumentação Cirúrgica Auxílio Farmácia Seguro de Vida Auxílio Funeral Programa Assistencial da gestação até o pós-parto Licença Parental Estendida Material Escolar Auxílio Creche Brinquedo de Natal Kit de Natal Programa de Assistência Psicológica, Jurídica e Financeira Clube de Vantagens e Descontos Universidade Corporativa  #VemPraRumo  Sobre a Rumo  Somos a maior operadora de logística ferroviária do Brasil, cruzamos o país de Norte a Sul, através de nossos quase 14 mil km de linhas, distância equivalente a uma viagem de São Paulo até a Austrália. Experience working on data-intensive, analytics, marketplace, or real estate technology platforms. Familiarity with mobile performance optimization and native module integrations. title: Software Engineer Technical Lead
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Software Engineer Technical Lead em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Sobre a Previdas A Previdas é uma healthtech/legaltech que conecta escritórios de advocacia previdenciária a médicos peritos para emissão de laudos técnicos. Operamos com receita recorrente, centenas de escritórios ativos e um time enxuto de produto e tecnologia. Buscamos um(a) engenheiro(a) de software sênior para liderar tecnicamente o time de desenvolvimento, combinando execução técnica de alto nível com a responsabilidade de elevar a qualidade e a maturidade da engenharia na empresa. Sobre a Vaga Esta é uma posição de liderança técnica com forte componente de execução. Você será responsável por definir padrões de engenharia, conduzir code reviews e orientar as decisões arquiteturais do time, ao mesmo tempo em que contribui diretamente no desenvolvimento de features e na resolução de problemas críticos em produção. É uma oportunidade para quem quer ter impacto real em um produto com usuários ativos e receita, com autonomia para moldar a direção técnica da plataforma. O que Esperamos Perfil Pragmatismo e foco em entrega — prioriza soluções funcionais e itera a partir delas Mentalidade de resolução definitiva — investiga a causa raiz em vez de tratar apenas os sintomas Visão de produto — entende que o valor de uma feature se mede pela experiência do usuário final Comunicação clara com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos Senso de prioridade — diferencia o que é urgente do que é interessante, e age de acordo Responsabilidades Definir e evoluir a arquitetura dos sistemas da Previdas, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, modularidade e alinhamento com a estratégia de produto. Liderar o processo de arquitetura da plataforma, consolidando sistemas legados e MVPs paralelos em uma estrutura coesa e sustentável. Atuar como referência técnica e liderança de engenharia para o time, orientando decisões arquiteturais, padrões de código, modelagem de domínio e boas práticas. Conduzir code reviews estratégicos, focando em qualidade, manutenibilidade, redução de complexidade e evolução contínua do código. Resolver incidentes críticos em produção, especialmente integrações com parceiros (APIs externas, webhooks, contratos de integração), garantindo estabilidade do ecossistema. Definir padrões de versionamento, documentação técnica e governança de código, promovendo previsibilidade e rastreabilidade. Apoiar decisões estratégicas de produto sob a ótica técnica, avaliando riscos, impacto arquitetural e viabilidade de novas iniciativas. Requisitos Obrigatórios Experiência sólida (mín. 4 anos) em arquitetura de software, com participação ativa em decisões estruturais e definição de padrões técnicos. Vivência prática com sistemas monolíticos e arquitetura orientada a serviços (microservices), compreendendo trade-offs, estratégias de modularização e evolução incremental. Domínio de modelagem de dados, estruturas de dados e bancos relacionais, incluindo desenho de schemas, performance, integridade e escalabilidade. Experiência comprovada em refatoração e modernização de sistemas legados, conduzindo upgrades de stack, reorganização arquitetural e redução de débito técnico. Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações web e boas práticas de segurança. Experiência com versionamento de código (Git), ambientes cloud e pipelines de CI/CD, promovendo automação, qualidade e previsibilidade nas entregas. Capacidade de comunicação estratégica em contexto de liderança técnica, traduzindo decisões arquiteturais para stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos. Diferenciais Experiência com as tecnologias utilizadas em nossos projetos, Angular, NestJS, MySQL. Vivência com Docker e orquestração de containers, conhecimento da DigitalOcean. Experiência prévia como referência técnica ou tech lead em times reduzidos Experiência com plataformas de telemedicina ou healthtech. Condições Contratação modelo PJ Trabalho 100% remoto Autonomia para definir padrões técnicos e direcionamento arquitetural Empresa com operação em fase Scale-up. Company Description  Leapcure is dedicated to making clinical trials more equitable by integrating emotional intelligence and a deep understanding of patient experiences into research. The organization goes beyond traditional patient recruitment by investing time to learn about each participant’s journey, needs, and motivations.  Leapcure also collaborates closely with research site staff, aiming to complement and strengthen their clinical research efforts. By focusing on meaningful patient engagement across diverse backgrounds, Leapcure is building a new category of patient engagement and clinical trial services. The team is committed to creating win-win-win outcomes for patients, sites, and sponsors. Job Description  We are seeking a Physician Advisor who will play a pivotal role in implementing and refining our physician outreach process to obtain patient referrals for a clinical trial studying Niemann-Pick Disease. This role is essential in ensuring participation in clinical trials, contributing significantly to groundbreaking medical advancements. Through dedicated communication and strategic relationship building, this position is key in advancing Leapcure's mission of connecting patients with life-changing medical research opportunities. Key Responsibilities: Actively grow our outreach network by adding new physicians, medical centers, and therapists to our contact list, ensuring a diverse and comprehensive range of medical professionals to reach out to. Increase the engagement level of physicians and healthcare providers, as evidenced by higher response rates, increased referrals, and more in-depth discussions about clinical trials. Effectively communicate and build relationships with healthcare professionals to significantly increase patient referrals for clinical trials. Provide insights and feedback on the physician outreach process, contributing to the development and implementation of more effective outreach strategies and tools. Maintain structured communication with the Leapcure team, providing weekly updates on outreach progress, challenges, and strategies.  Qualifications: Doctor of Medicine (MD) or equivalent, specialized in Pediatric Neurology or Pediatric Endocrinology  with strong understanding of medical terminology, clinical practices, and healthcare systems. Clinical or research experience with Niemann-Pick Disease is preferred. Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of clearly conveying complex medical information to a diverse range of medical professionals. Proven ability to establish and maintain professional relationships with physicians, medical centers, and therapists. Ability to develop and implement effective outreach strategies that align with Leapcure’s goals. Excellent organizational and time-management skills, capable of managing multiple tasks efficiently. Competence in identifying challenges in the outreach process and brainstorming practical solutions. Ability to work collaboratively with team members, sharing insights and participating in regular meetings. Capacity to adapt to changing project needs and a dynamic clinical trial outreach environment. Strong ethical grounding in handling sensitive information and maintaining confidentiality. Interest in and understanding of clinical research. Fluency in English and Portuguese. Additional language skills are a plus. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the advancement of medical research and patient care. If you are passionate about making a difference in the medical community and possess the required skills and experience, we encourage you to apply.  Compensation  $50 USD per hour (255 Brazilian Reais per hour)  **This is a remote contract position** Comfort working remotely, managing time effectively, and collaborating asynchronously with a distributed team is a must. Commitment to equity in healthcare, cultural humility, and inclusion of diverse patient populations in research.

title: Head of Operations (Integrator)
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Head of Operations (Integrator) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

THE ROLE  We're looking for a sharp, systems-obsessed operator to run the business behind the founder. You'll take problems off the founder's plate and turn ambiguity into working systems — documenting how things run, building the processes, and making sure initiatives actually ship instead of dying half-built. This is the Integrator to a Visionary. The founder generates direction and ideas; you turn them into scoped projects, tight SOPs, and machines that run without him in the room. You're the person who closes the open loops, chases the last 10%, and owns the operational backbone so nothing lives only in someone's head. This is a high-trust, high-ownership role. If you're energized by walking into chaos and bringing order to it, you'll thrive. If you need detailed instructions for every task or you're secretly a visionary waiting for your turn, this isn't the right fit. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING  Turning the founder's half-formed directives into scoped, sequenced, shipped projects Documenting how the business runs — SOPs, checklists, and playbooks that become the single source of truth Building and maintaining our operational backbone: CRM workflows, automations, and data flow across our stack (GoHighLevel) Owning our dashboards and reporting — keeping the numbers trustworthy and turning raw data into \"here's what's working, here's what's broken, here's what needs a decision\" Being the operational point of contact for our sales team (closers, setters) and new hires so they're not all routing through the founder Running the operating rhythm: standups, weekly check-ins, scorecard reviews, and holding people to deliverables Managing our software stack and vendors so the founder isn't the one on support calls Being first line on operational fires — diagnosing and fixing, or escalating with a recommendation, not just flagging that something broke  WHO YOU ARE  You have 2+ years in operations, chief of staff, or project/implementation roles (fast-scaling startup, agency, or lead-gen business preferred) You're fluent in English — genuinely fluent, comfortable translating intent into systems and managing people, not just reading Slack You think in systems: you see a messy process and your instinct is to map it, fix the breakpoint, and document it so it never breaks the same way twice You finish things — you're the person who closes the last 10% instead of leaving projects 90% done You're comfortable being the #2 and the person behind the scenes; you get energy from making someone else's vision real, not from being the face You're coachable and process-disciplined, but you operate with judgment — you bring solutions, not just problems You're organized, self-directed, and thrive with ownership instead of someone standing over your shoulder You have a reliable internet connection, a quiet space for calls, and a professional setup

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:

Role Overview  We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities  FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.)  on markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks  across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades  to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics  across EM FX markets.  Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies  to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools  where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization . Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers  via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners  across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs  and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure  supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements  Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience  in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets  NDF markets and offshore hedging  Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks  Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems  Hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation platforms  Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments . Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks . Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations . Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources . Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies . Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations . Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Atuar em desafios de modelagem preditiva, incluindo previsão de demanda, identificação de padrões comportamentais, otimização e apoio à tomada de decisão. Estruturar abordagens robustas de experimentação, validação e monitoramento de modelos, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução contínua das soluções. Construir pipelines analíticos escaláveis para preparação, transformação e exploração de grandes volumes de dados. Trabalhar em parceria com times multidisciplinares para transformar problemas ambíguos em soluções analíticas aplicáveis e escaláveis. Liderar discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura analítica, boas práticas de modelagem e evolução da disciplina de ciência de dados. Explorar e desenvolver soluções baseadas em IA aplicada, incluindo agentes inteligentes, automação de processos analíticos e uso de modelos generativos quando fizer sentido para o problema. Apoiar a operacionalização de soluções analíticas em produção, incluindo monitoramento, performance e governança. Comunicar recomendações, aprendizados e trade-offs técnicos de forma clara para stakeholders técnicos e de negócio. Experiência sólida em modelagem preditiva aplicada a problemas complexos de negócio, incluindo previsão de demanda e séries temporais, com domínio de algoritmos de machine learning supervisionado como XGBoost, LightGBM e CatBoost. Proficiência em Python e SQL para análise, modelagem e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados. Experiência com ambientes cloud e ecossistemas analíticos escaláveis (BigQuery, Airflow ou similares). Capacidade de transformar problemas de negócio pouco estruturados em soluções analíticas robustas. Experiência com implantação, monitoramento e evolução de modelos em produção. Forte capacidade analítica, pensamento crítico e excelente comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos. Noções de MLOps. Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.  Diferenciais  Experiência com IA generativa, LLMs e desenvolvimento de agentes. Vivência com frameworks como LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI ou similares. Experiência em varejo. Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling. Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.  #SeleçãoSBF #vempraSBF

description:

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer  who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations  behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you’re someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you’ll feel at home here. This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion  within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us. What you’ll do  Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models  for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling  to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions  that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences  within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.  What we’re looking for  We’re intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you’re strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we’d love to hear from you. You’ll be successful  in this role if you have : Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms  (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning  (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).  Nice to have (not required) Experience with NLP and/or LLMs  (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS , such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval .  Why Join Us  You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You’ll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction. Equal Opportunity  Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"  Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!  A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia!  Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.  Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.  Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.  Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.  Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.  REQUISITOS   Formação Acadêmica:   Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).  Certificações:   Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho); ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;  Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais. Competências Comportamentais:  Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho:  REMOTO Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo. IMPORTANTE:  MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:  Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Lead Product Designer em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Who are we?  Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role  This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities  Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.  Must haves  6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.  Nice to have  Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

Ao longo do caminho, você se unirá a colegas inspiradores e encontrará uma riqueza de clientes, culturas e experiências. Oferecemos desafios motivadores, experiências memoráveis e oportunidades para moldar seu futuro. Inclusão e Diversidade  Estamos orgulhosos de ser diferente e isso começa com nossa gente. A individualidade é o que nos torna grandes, queremos que cada um traga seu eu completo para o trabalho e crie algo surpreendente. É com isso que nos preocupamos. Portanto, quer você se junte a nós, quer procure mudar para uma parte diferente do negócio, nós trabalhamos duro para garantir a criação de oportunidades iguais para todos. Nossas 8 maneiras  Com mais de 48.000 especialistas dedicados em 145 mercados, nossas '8 maneiras' formam e guiam a maneira como fazemos as coisas aqui, de modo que, juntos, podemos alcançar o 'nunca antes' para nossos clientes, para a sociedade e uns para os outros. Nós sonhamos alto. Inspiramos mudanças. Formamos equipes sem limites. Todos nós lideramos. Tornamos isso realidade. Escalamos alto. Escolhemos a emoção. Somos uma força para o bem. description:

We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager  Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.  This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.  What you’ll do: • Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more • Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where • Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms • Help shape the voice and presence of brands online • Analyze performance and double down on what works Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.) Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips  2. Podcast Clip Strategy Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan  Decide what clips get posted, when, and where  Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)  3. Growth & Optimization Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase: Views Engagement Follower growth A/B test captions, formats, and posting times  4. Platform Expertise Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)  5. Systems & Organization Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system  Track posted content and performance metrics Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting  6. Collaboration Work closely with: Editors (to refine clips) Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals) Leadership (to align on growth strategy)  What we’re looking for: • Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video) • Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts • Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior • Ability to manage both content output + community interaction  Must-Haves 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content) Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video  Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts Strong instincts for what makes content go viral  Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day) Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing.   Nice-to-Haves Experience working with podcasts or long-form content Background in content editing or scripting Familiarity with tools like: Asana/ Slack Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.) Analytics tools Experience managing multiple brands or clients  Bonus: • Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands • Background in content editing or scripting • Experience building or managing online communities This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

title: English Teacher
description:
Confira a oportunidade para English Teacher em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?  You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:  Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.  Minimum Requirements:  Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.  Who we are:  Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Especialista Técnico SAP I
description:

Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP. Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento. Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes. Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis. Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time. Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio:  Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP. Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas. Desenvolvimentos e Projetos:  Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto. Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações \"Z\" tradicionais em favor de extensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes. Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance. Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna. title: Professor de francês
description:
Empresa está contratando Professor de francês em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!   Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!  A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.  Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.  Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*  O que oferecemos?  Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos  de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais  com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva  para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.  Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?  Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.  Necessário:  Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais  para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.  O diferencial?  Aqui você é mais que um professor.  Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii  com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.  Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço?  Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as  Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?  Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.  Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

Experiência prévia em prospecção, pré-vendas (SDR, BDR, Inside Sales) ou vendas internas em empresas de tecnologia ou SaaS. Pode ser pouca, mas tem que ser real. description:

Role Overview  We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities  Business Development & Partnerships  Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)  Market & Network Development  Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape  Execution & Collaboration  Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships  Banking & Infrastructure Setup  Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement  Requirements  5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM   Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Empresa está contratando AI Development Orchestrator em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Location:  Remote Type:  Full-Time Reports to:  CEO Stack:  TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:  Immediate The Company  Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role  You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do  Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\" Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.  Must-Haves  Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.  Strong Signals  Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.  Red Flags  AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.  Who This Person Is  3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving. How We Evaluate  No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.  What We Offer  A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.  To Apply or Refer  Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

About the Company Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions. About the Role  The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities  Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations. Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities. Track progress and make sure work is moving forward. Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early. Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps. Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.  Qualifications  5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.  Required Skills  ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows.  What Success Looks Like  Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps. Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination. Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision. Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates. Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly. Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process.  Ideal Candidate  The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Professor de inglês em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!   Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!  A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.  Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.  Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*  O que oferecemos?  Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos  de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais  com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva  para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.  Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?  Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.  Necessário:  Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais  para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.  O diferencial?  Aqui você é mais que um professor.  Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii  com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.  Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço?  Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as  Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?  Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.  Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente
